test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Six letters U, V, W, X, Y and Z are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure below. Find the letter on the face opposite to Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60dd396ca7acd1756633d3bb4d4c861eb86ee3c119399050c7f3472d86477b55.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As W is common on both the dices, it is clear that U, Y, V, and Z are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. X will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65eff75e072ca0059ff8ad0cae7664314a25e85030a317c835f4cf7fe15b2a02.png] 

Opposite pairs:

U → V

Y → Z

W → X

So, the opposite side of "Z" will be side "Y".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
